title: Pending media looks saved before its upload completes
preconditions: A saves a photo memory on a slow or interrupted connection.
The composer renders a local preview before the server upload completes.
A closes the app while the upload is pending.

actions.note: A attaches a photo and sends.

expected_behavior: Pending is visually and semantically distinct from saved.
The draft survives the app being closed.
Retry produces one completed memory, not a duplicate.
candidate_failure_modes: The local preview is read as confirmation of a completed save.
The pending item disappears after relaunch.
Retry creates a second memory or loses the attachment.

observed_code_behavior: The product requires pending, failed, and saved states to be distinguishable.
The owner's physical two-phone acceptance run remains the gate for native UX.
documented_requirement: Pending is visually and semantically distinct from saved.
The draft survives the app being closed.
Retry produces one completed memory, not a duplicate.
hypothetical_user_behavior:
A fictional participant (Theo Bennett) said: "Did this on a train last night, one bar of signal, large text on, split screen. Three things I'd remove outright:

1) The recovery phrase check. It asks me to re-enter words I wrote down twenty seconds earlier. It has never caught a mistake that restore didn't catch anyway, and it costs a full screen plus a keyboard on a phone. The cost: I nearly lost the draft when I rotated the phone — back button took the whole screen with it.

2) The per-device "trust code" in the device list. I have never once compared it with another human. If the code matters, verify it once at enrollment and then stop showing it as a permanent badge. A code nobody reads is decoration.

3) The helper line that says the connection is lost while the upload is visibly pending. That's the app lying about network state. I retried a six-character code three times because of it, and the code field wouldn't take a pasted message anyway.

The one thing I'd keep: the pending upload indicator — but make it say *what* is pending and when it last tried. That's the only line in the flow that told me the truth.

Everything else in that walkthrough was a warning explaining a warning. Remove, don't redesign."
Theo Bennett assumes: a pending upload is visibly pending
Theo Bennett assumes: a six-character code accepts a pasted message
Nadia Iqbal assumes: a disabled button explains why
Nadia Iqbal assumes: a save has a visible pending and failure state
